notes: PREMISE CORRECTION: the task brief stated this decision_id range 'includes shift+2 psalms 51/52/54/60'. This is factually incorrect for m8-mesh-r3 Ps: decision_id 271-400 spans parent psalms 87-118 only (verified against all 130 rows in range, not just the 11 sampled); psalms 51/52/54/60 do not occur in this range at all. All Hebrew quotes were extracted programmatically via regex over the row JSON's own text fields (never hand-typed or retyped) and collated against verse_map_oshb.json using ps_lib.collate_hebrew; all 40+ extracted quote runs across the 11 sampled rows matched at BYTE tier.
All 38 web:X=oshb:Y dual-cite pairs found across the 11 rows were re-derived via ps_lib.web_to_mt() (never hand-computed) and all matched the row's stated MT reference exactly.

An independent sweep (query spliced from the actual 118:21 verb token, never hand-typed) returns 14 verses at skeleton tier, 11 at accent_stripped, and 3 at byte tier -- no tier supports the stated count of 2.
